_doc: no-solana-copy allowlist (Canton port, C4c). Each entry is a line of copy that names Solana ON PURPOSE: the product's
lineage, credited honestly. `match` is a substring of that line; `why` says why it stays.
The rule fails on an entry that no longer matches anything, so the list cannot rot.

entries.why: SOL names the listed Solana price asset; trading and settlement remain on Canton.
The registry identifies the traded price asset, not a Solana wallet or execution network.
